{{Quote|When Sith have nightmares, I am the face they see.|Darth Phobos|<ref name="TFU databank" />}}
'''Darth Phobos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and lived thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Cunning and manipulative, Phobos [[Death/Legends|slew]] many of her [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] brethren in a bid for power, and the rest turned against her and attempted to kill her. Phobos survived the attempt on her life and assembled a fanatical [[Cult of Darth Phobos|cult]] that worshiped her, using the [[Sith cult/Legends|cultists]] to strike against Sith and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] alike and earning the nickname '''"The Hidden Fear"''' among the Sith. Eventually, a joint force of Jedi and Sith [[Battle against Darth Phobos|killed Phobos]], but her cult continued to live on until the [[Fourth Great Schism]].

Tales of Phobos' survival became an urban legend, and her image was incorporated into the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] as a simulation for the "Trial of Insight." In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], that simulation [[Starkiller's Trial of Insight|battled]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] secret [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], and was defeated.

==Biography==
===The Hidden Fear===
{{Quote|The scent of your fear is&hellip;intoxicating&hellip;|Darth Phobos|<ref name="TFU databank" />}}
[[File:Phobos_databank.jpg|thumb|left|Darth Phobos]]
Darth Phobos was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] born on the ancestral [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] burial-[[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] [[Time/Legends|eons]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Phobos was a manipulative individual who developed her mental [[Force power/Legends|powers]], using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Mind trick/Legends|control]] the minds of the weak and forcing them to obey her commands. Phobos [[Death/Legends|murdered]] many of her rivals in her quest for power. Eventually, the Sith turned on her and destroyed her [[Starship/Legends|starship]] while it was in low-[[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Korriban. Phobos was presumed dead, but she had in fact survived and gone into hiding.<ref name="TFU databank" />

During the course of the several [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] that followed, Phobos assembled a fanatical [[Cult of Darth Phobos|cult]] devoted exclusively to her. She dispatched her [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolytes]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to recruit others and to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] both [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Sith leaders indiscriminately. Eventually, the Sith began to suspect that Phobos had somehow returned from the dead and began to refer to her as "The Hidden Fear." Both factions recognized Phobos and her [[Sith cult/Legends|cult]] as a major threat to the galaxy and grudgingly joined forces to stop her. Phobos was eventually killed in a [[Battle against Darth Phobos|battle]] against Jedi and Sith warriors, but her cult remained active for a long time afterward, disappearing only around the [[Fourth Great Schism|onset]] of the [[New Sith Wars]]<ref name="TFU databank" /> in [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

===Legacy===
{{Quote|I'm going to enjoy this&hellip;|Darth Phobos, before her duel with Starkiller|<ref name="TFU databank" />}}
[[File:StarkillerfightsPhobos.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darth Phobos' simulacrum, dueling Starkiller]]
Rumors of Phobos' survival persisted for many centuries, and "The Hidden Fear" eventually became a subject of ghost stories that Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] told each other.<ref name="TFU databank" /> A visage of Darth Phobos also became a key part of the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] that Padawans took in order to become full-fledged [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]. Appearing inside the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Phobos simulation constituted the "Trial of Insight," meant to challenge Padawans to confront their deepest fears and to teach them to see clearly through deception.<ref name="TFU databank trial of insight">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' video game]] {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PS2]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]], and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]] versions' in-game databank}}
 '''Trial of Insight''' entry.</ref> The Phobos simulation remained active<ref name="TFU" /> even after [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], when the Jedi Temple was ransacked and left in ruins.<ref name="NEC" />

Around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]],<ref name="TFUn">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' dates the [[Corellian Treaty]], an event that served as the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. According to [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''The Force Unleashed'' novel]], the signing of the Corellian Treaty occurred roughly a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]] was nearly [[Death/Legends|killed]] aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] by his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. As the encounter with [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Phobos in [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' video game]] occurs before the events on the ''Executor'', the duel can be approximately dated to [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].</ref> [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|secret apprentice]], [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], visited the Jedi Temple as part of his [[Sith training]]. When he reached the lower [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]] level of the abandoned Temple, Darth Phobos' simulacrum [[Starkiller's Trial of Insight|confronted]] him, appearing as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], one of the few people for whom Starkiller cared, and pretending to be in pain. When Starkiller approached her, Phobos attacked him, armed with a [[Darth Phobos's lightsaber|double-bladed lightsaber]]. During their [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], Phobos frequently duplicated and changed her appearance to that of Eclipse, claiming to have [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] that the Captain's death was the thing Starkiller feared the most and that he would hesitate to attack her. Nevertheless, Starkiller defeated Phobos and, after [[Telekinesis/Legends|hurling]] her throughout the Archives with the Force, was prepared to strike a final blow. Phobos changed her appearance to that of Eclipse for the final time, begging the Sith apprentice to spare her. However, Starkiller did not fall for the deception and [[Shiak|stabbed]] Phobos through the back with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], ending the simulation.<ref name="TFU" />

By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the technical readout of the [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] that Phobos had used during her life came into possession of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Alliance [[Staff Sergeant/Legends|Staff Sergeant]] [[Levardio]], stationed at the [[Zephyr Base]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], offered the readout for sale to Rebels who performed valiantly on the battlefields of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], allowing the buyer to create his or her own replica of Phobos' lightsaber after acquiring all the necessary resources.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I will crush you, and your terror will sustain me for another millennia!|Darth Phobos|<ref name="TFU databank" />}}
Darth Phobos was a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned Theelin female with blue [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TFU" /> She was talented in manipulation of other beings and did not hesitate to kill those who stood in her way, which eventually turned her fellow Sith against her. Seeking vengeance after the attempt on her life, she assembled a fanatical cult and slaughtered many Jedi and Sith alike. Although the Sith initially believed her to be dead, they began to suspect Phobos' hand in the string of murders that followed and dubbed her "The Hidden Fear." After her legitimate death, rumors of Phobos' survival persisted for centuries, and she became a subject of ghost stories among Jedi Padawans.<ref name="TFU databank" /> The simulation of Phobos that fought against Starkiller was intent on discovering his fear and used all of her mental powers to confuse the Sith apprentice. Phobos discovered that Starkiller's innermost fear was the loss of Captain Eclipse and sensed that there was only one person of whom the Sith apprentice was truly afraid.<ref name="TFU" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Get out of my head, witch!''"<br />"''I will find the truth. I will find what you fear most.|Starkiller and Darth Phobos, during their duel|<ref name="TFU databank" />}}
[[File:Phobos_saber.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Darth Phobos's lightsaber]]
Darth Phobos exhibited powerful mental powers that she could use to manipulate the minds of the weak and force them to do her bidding.<ref name="TFU databank" /> The Phobos simulation also appeared to be proficient with the Force, able to sense her opponent's deepest fears and use them against the assailant.<ref name="TFU" /> She fed on phobias, and was strengthened by those of her opponents.<ref name="Guide">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'': Prima Official Game Guide]] {{C|[[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]] version}}</ref> During her duel with Starkiller, the simulation of Phobos fooled him into seeing more than one version of herself and clouded his vision, making Starkiller temporarily lose all sense of direction. She also employed a powerful [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] volley against the aspiring Sith and was adept in various forms of telekinesis, including Force Repulse and Saber Throw. The simulacrum was proficient with her double-bladed lightsaber. She occasionally used [[Force speed/Legends|Force speed]] and [[Force jump/Legends|jump]] to increase her agility, and was capable of quickly [[Teleportation (Force power)/Legends|teleporting]] from one point to another.<ref name="TFU" />

==Equipment==
Darth Phobos wore an outfit consisting of purple [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and gray metal [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating. She wielded a double-bladed ligthsaber.<ref name="TFU" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TFU_cover_art.png|thumb|right|250px|Cover art of ''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'', where Darth Phobos first appeared]]
Darth Phobos first appeared in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'', voiced by [[Kari Wahlgren]]. Phobos was featured in one of the Jedi Temple levels exclusive to the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]], and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Nintendo Wii]] versions of the game, which were developed by [[Krome Studios]]. In ''The Force Unleashed'', entering "HIDDENFEAR" as a cheat code enables Phobos as a playable character skin. In addition, Phobos is a playable character in the Wii and PSP versions' respective duel modes, although she has to be unlocked first.<ref name="TFU" /> Simultaneously to the game's [[September 16]] release,<ref name="The Force Will Be Unleashed on September 16">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20080403.html|text=The Force Will Be Unleashed on September 16}}</ref> on the same day,<ref name="Date">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Unleashed-Official-Guides/dp/0761559167|text=Star Wars The Force Unleashed 2: Prima Official Game Guide (Prima Official Game Guides)}}</ref> [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Prima Official Game Guide|''The Force Unleashed: Prima Official Game Guide'']] was released, and according to that book, Darth Phobos' name is inspired by the word "[[Wikipedia:Phobia|phobia]]."<ref name="Guide" />

''The Force Unleashed'' left the exact nature of Phobos' appearance in the game ambiguous. The only implication, provided in the game's databank entry for "Jedi Trials," was that the simulacrum was projected with the Force. In [[2010]], the reference book [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']] presented another possible explanation. The book featured a description of a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holographic projector]] installed inside the Jedi Temple after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]] for use during the Jedi Trials. The projector was capable of creating [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] simulations of long-dead [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] "monsters." The book's author, [[Daniel Wallace]], later confirmed in his blog that he included this line as a reference to Darth Phobos and [[Darth Desolous]]&mdash;another Sith simulation from ''The Force Unleashed''&mdash;but he did not spell their names out in order to avoid any potential timeline conflict.<ref name="Endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2010/12/endnotes-for-star-wars-jedi-path-part-3.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Jedi Path (part 3 of 4)}}</ref>
